verified_good_products.title: Steel Moduler Isolation Room
verified_good_products.description:
Whitenair Isolation Rooms

Whitenair Technologies has introduced negative pressure/Positive Pressure isolation Rooms that are fully fabricated off site to help hospitals increase single occupancy isolation space as quickly as possible.

Whitenair Technologies  a modular Clean room construction provider has announced it now offers a way for medical facilities to create and expand their infectious patient isolation areas with  .modular isolation Rooms with the growing corona virus pandemic spreading   across India and Globally .

 

Using a panelised wall system, the isolation rooms are fully fabricated in Whitenair's modular construction facilities. The components are  then delivered and assembled on sit. This design allows for  pre fabricated, quickly assembled isolation rooms that have fully customised layout and designs.

 

Whitenair's  isolation rooms offer options(where situation warrant) for HVAC Systems with Fan filter Units(FFU)  to keep the room at appropriate temperatures and constantly filter particles with HEPA filteration and UV light from the environment's air supply with the numerous air exchanges per hour

 

Patient isolation Rooms can be customised with a negative pressure environment for patients who may have an impaired immune system and may be carrier for other infectious dises that are airborne spred rather than the droplet corona virus.

 

Diseases such as TB, Measles, Mumps, Varicella and other respiratory infections fall in to the airborne category. When  the negative pressure  isolation rooms is needed the air pressure inside the isolation  room is lower than entrance ante room to keep air flowing in to the patient isolation room instead of  out , thus   keeping any contaminants or particles from escaping the room.

 

All isolation rooms should be used in conjunction with proper staff and equipment sanitising and hospital contamination control procedures.
